name: Hall of Other Selves
introDiscord:
A mirrored hall stretches ahead.

Your reflection waves.

You did not wave.

Shizuki's warning:

'If you meet me:

ask something only I know.

Actually there are multiple me's.

Never mind.

RUN.'
introTwitch:
A mirrored hall stretches ahead.

Your reflection waves.

You did not wave.

Shizuki's warning:

'If you meet me:

ask something only I know.

Actually there are multiple me's.

Never mind.

RUN.'

hall-of-other-selves-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Hall of Other Selves.

left.message: A reflection steps out of the glass and copies your stance perfectly.

right.message:
One Berry rests beneath a note signed:

'Shizuki.'

Below it:

'REAL Shizuki.'

Below that:

'ACTUAL REAL SHIZUKI.'

Administrative crisis.

forward.message:
Three versions of the same coffer exist behind three mirrors.

Only one bites.

You choose wisely.

hall-of-other-selves-depths.prompt: Deeper within Hall of Other Selves, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: A reflection of Shizuki's peaceful camp becomes tangible.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message:
A Mirror-Self Mimic becomes an excellent copy of you.

Rude.

forward.message: Star Candies rest beside reflections of choices you never made.

hall-of-other-selves-threshold.prompt: Near Mirror of Abandoned Paths, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A chest contains souvenirs from paths you did not take.

right.message:
A mirror shows you completely rested.

For once, the Nexus copies the useful version.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: Your reflection steps forward before you do.

boss-antechamber.name: Mirror of Abandoned Paths
boss-antechamber.prompt: Mirror of Abandoned Paths shows hundreds of versions of the journey.

bossPromptDiscord:
Mirror of Abandoned Paths shows hundreds of versions of the journey.

One reflection remains when all others disappear.

Use /yes to approach or /no to avoid fighting the version
of yourself that apparently made different life choices.
bossPromptTwitch:
Mirror of Abandoned Paths shows hundreds of versions of the journey.

One reflection remains when all others disappear.

Use !yes to approach or !no to avoid fighting the version
of yourself that apparently made different life choices.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Mirror of Abandoned Paths. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The reflection steps through.

Unchosen Reflection reveals itself!

completionText:
The mirrors become ordinary.

One contains an old message:

'Met alternate me.

She ALSO gets lost.

Universal constant confirmed.'
